teaser: What does it mean to be the one everyone trusts to finish the job, while privately rehearsing all the ways it might fall apart? You are a 4, an INFJ, and that question sits at the center of you more than most. The 4 wants solid ground, step by step, the same routine repeated until it holds. The INFJ sees around corners — the shift coming before anyone names it. In you those two don't cancel out. The foundation gets poured, but part of you is picturing the day it will need replacing.
